title: Too narrow at the bottom
text: Too narrow at the bottom. I got this for my coffee tumbler but because the bottom is so narrow it won't fit far enough up my cup for me to actually use it. I can't use it where it reaches or my cup will be top heavy.

product_metadata.title: PopSockets PopThirst Cup Sleeve, Drink Holder, Koozie - BoysenBerry Mandala
features: Meet your elevated, insulated koozie with an integrated PopGrip for the ultimate grasp to avoid spills.
Easily grip your hot or cold beverage with our PopGrip coozie and then collapse it flat when you are done for no-fuss pocketability and storage.
Pop Thirst coozies keep your cold beverages cold & your hot beverages hot.
PopSockets PopThirst is reusable and eco-friendly.
Fits most standard cup sizes. Designed to fit coffee cups, pint glasses and various beverage cups.
description: Leverage your beverage with the ultimate cold drink holder! The PopThirst Can Holder offers a secure grip to more easily hold your drink and avoid spills. Keep your drink cold, your hands comfy, and your drink stylish. Keep your lattes hot or your beers cold. The PopThirst cup sleeve fits most standard cup sizes. Dimensions: Flat: 3.39” H x 5.04” W x 0.43” Thick (86mm H x 128mm W x 11mm). With Cup: 3.39” H x 3.35” Diameter (86mm H x 85mm)
